item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud dur khrod gnas brgyad mkha' 'gro'i bzlog pa
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan phag gi lo'i zla tshes la/ ka ke'u seng ge yang rdzong nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs seng gdong phug nas spyan drangs shing / slar zla tshes la pho brang drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse nas shog ser bod yig du (tu) phab grub pa'o//
